rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Cinderfi provides 19 retirement planning tools covering Canadian and US pension systems (CPP/OAS, Social Security), registered account strategies (RRSP/TFSA, 401k/IRA), tax-aware withdrawal optimization, Monte Carlo simulations, and historical backtesting for both single and coupled scenarios. Requires a free API key from cinderfi.com/mcp.
